summary.text: Lamont Bagby is a Democratic member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 14, which covers parts of Henrico County and Richmond City, and has served in the Senate since 2023.
Bagby sits on the Senate committees on Transportation; Commerce and Labor; Education and Health; Finance and Appropriations; and Rules, and chairs Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Lamont Bagby was born in Richmond, Virginia on December 21, 1976, according to the Senate profile.
The profile lists Bagby's education as Virginia Commonwealth University (M.Ed Educational Leadership) and Norfolk State University (B.S. Business Education).
Lamont Bagby was a member of the House of Delegates from 2015-2023, according to the profile.
